changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape name in users (store raw, escape at render)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET name = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(name, ''', ''''), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&') WHERE name ~ '&(amp|lt|gt|quot|#039|#39);'

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape town in users (store raw, escape at render)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET town = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(town, ''', ''''), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&') WHERE town ~ '&(amp|lt|gt|quot|#039|#39);'

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape new values (name, town) in user_log.info hstore
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_log SET info = info || hstore('name', replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(info->'name', ''', ''''), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&')) WHERE action = 'set_info' AND info->'name' ~ '&(amp|lt|gt|quot|#039|#39);'

UPDATE user_log SET info = info || hstore('town', replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(info->'town', ''', ''''), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&')) WHERE action = 'set_info' AND info->'town' ~ '&(amp|lt|gt|quot|#039|#39);'

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_log SET info = info || hstore('old_town', replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(info->'old_town', ''', ''''), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&')) WHERE action = 'reset_town' AND info->'old_town' ~ '&(amp|lt|gt|quot|#039|#39);'
